title: ammodenia peploides subsp. major
intro: Ammodenia peploides subsp. major, commonly known as the "Tropical Jasmine" or "Night-Blooming Jasmine", is a species of flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, making it useful for treating wounds, fever, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to reduce inflammation, calm the nervous system, and exhibit antioxidant activity, which contributes to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Ammodenia peploides subsp. major include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
